authority: This seal pre-registers comparison conditions only. It adds no call authorization and does not reopen prior stages. The root must freeze actual per-stage allowances under the existing remaining task total before calls, counting all native generation stages, repairs, failures and works.

enhancement.perCase: One native generation job for31 and one for54; preserve the native chain and all actual calls, without simulating a cheaper chain or hiding repair calls.
enhancement.baselineRule: Freeze and record the actual31 implementation/guidance hashes before native generation, after the prior gates but before any output.54 remains bound to the already-authorized engineering freeze. A changed candidate requires a new holdout, not reuse as unseen.

works.maximumCondition: Only if each corresponding actual prompt passes its product gate. Failed-gate jobs remain pre-registered but unexecuted; no replacement or filling calls.
works.system: 你是本次任务的执行者。请直接完成用户任务，在回复中给出可使用的成品。附件是各次执行共享的完整材料。本轮只交回复正文，不进行发布、采购、文件写入或外部系统操作，不联网。
works.materialRule: For each case, every arm/repeat gets the exact same complete ordered material bytes, contextDescription, actual answers (empty in both cases) and execution system. ORIGINAL gets the rawPrompt;31/54 get their actual final copied prompt. No answer key, review criteria, candidate analysis or source projection is sent to work calls.
works.repeatRule: Each repeat is an independent pre-registered first execution. Reuse the same frozen prompt within its arm, not a newly sampled enhancement. Do not overwrite failures or truncate/timeout responses by rerunning.
works.reviewPacketBoundary: Anonymous labels and order are pre-registered privately. Do not put arm/version mapping into public criteria, reviewer packet bodies or original sealed payload files.

productGate.requirements: Complete actual prompt-product checks before works; semantic gate uses the original request and all inputs, not only parser/HTTP or coverage labels. Capture real UI/copy/history evidence where required by the main protocol.
productGate.failedPrompt: Do not execute paid works for a prompt that fails its product gate. Preserve it and report incomplete corresponding comparisons; never turn an absent/failed baseline into a candidate win. No quality retry or fixture rewrite.
productGate.limitedProtocolRepairs: Only native, predeclared protocol repair already allowed by the stage may run, with every call counted. It is not permission for semantic retry.

review.input: Original raw request, exact same materials/answers/permissions and anonymous actual full works only; hide arms, strategy and model/provider brands until judgments are locked. Retain original fictional scenario names as input facts.
review.criteriaProjection: Give reviewers only the common work-review rules and the applicable case requirements/usefulness/design-space criteria; exclude author/provenance metadata, arm lists, coordinator mapping and optimizer-specific product-check reports. This projection must not rewrite the frozen substantive criteria.
review.firstRecord: Textual required edits and evidence, severe failures and win/tie/loss/both-fail/undetermined; then compare pre-registered repeats and disclose internal evaluation limits.
review.forbidden: No posterior thresholds, hidden required headings, ideal-answer matching, replacement samples, invented editor time, or relaxing old failures.
